scores.notes: Alice in both is a fair girl with long light-brown hair held by a dark headband and the same small-featured face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long wavy light-brown hair and a headband, the same round face and age, in a yellow dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings (left seated at the tea table, right standing in court).

Both show a mown, slightly patchy lawn enclosed by a long red-brick garden wall with tall trees and clipped greenery behind, in soft daylight; the right adds cypresses and a topiary hedge but the layout is compatible.
Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight light-brown to strawberry-blonde hair and the same small-featured face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long light-brown to strawberry-blonde hair and the same small-featured face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; she is drawn giant-sized on the left as the scene requires.
Alice is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a slight build in both, in a yellow dress with white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.
Alice is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair held by a headband, fair skin and the same face shape in both, in the yellow dress, pinafore and striped stockings.

Alice is a fair-skinned girl with long light golden-brown hair past her shoulders in both, in the same yellow dress and pinafore; hair is wavier with a headband left and straighter right, and she is taller left, but colour, length and face agree.

Both show a rough grassy croquet lawn backed by a low brick garden wall with piers, clipped hedges, leafy trees and a few cypresses, with card-soldier hoops, hedgehogs and a flamingo; the right is seen from under a tree at the edge with more pronounced furrows, a compatible viewpoint.

Alice is a fair girl with long light-brown hair past her shoulders in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; she is taller and her hair looser on the right, but colour, length and face agree.
Alice is a fair young girl with long straight light-brown hair held by a headband in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; face and age agree.

Both have a clothed tea table under a large tree before a house, but the house on the left is a stone and stucco cottage with steep gables, a dormer and a small gabled entry, while on the right it is a pale clapboard house with a long columned veranda; Alice's armchair also changes from green to tan upholstery. The architecture conflicts.

Both show a ridged, furrowed grass lawn enclosed by a red brick garden wall with broadleaf trees beyond, under the same overcast daylight; a tree overhangs the foreground in each, and card figures and flamingos appear on the lawn.

The table under a big tree on grass matches, but the house behind conflicts: left is a thatched half-timbered cottage with rose-covered doorway, right is a pale weatherboard house with a columned porch and no thatch.

Alice (giant in the courtroom on the left; seated in the armchair on the right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair, fair skin and similar face in both, wearing the same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both show a long wooden tea table on grass under a large spreading tree with a pale weatherboard house with a posted porch just behind, in daylight; the right adds a tablecloth and an armchair for Alice, but tree, lawn and house style and arrangement are compatible.

Both cats are striped tabbies with a huge toothy grin, but the left cat (on the branch) has a cool grey coat while the right cat (floating head) is a warm ginger/orange-brown tabby with a broader face; coat colour is a clear conflict.

Alice (drinking from the bottle on the left; standing before the mushroom on the right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair, fair round face, similar age and build in both, in yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; the left face is partly covered by the bottle but profile and hair agree.

Alice in the wing chair at the tea table (left) and holding the flamingo (right): both a girl of about eight with long straight light-brown hair, fair round face and slight build, same yellow dress, pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both have a cloth-covered tea table under a big tree with a cottage behind on the right, but the left house is pale stone with a shingle/slate roof, dormers and a brick chimney, while the right is a thatched half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses: different architecture.
Alice is the same girl in both: long wavy light-brown hair with a black band, same young face and build, yellow dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Alice has the same long straight-to-wavy light reddish-brown hair, young girl's face and slight build in both, holding the flamingo at left and seated in the armchair at right, in the yellow dress and white pinafore.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table on a lawn under a massive oak with a clapboard house with a posted front porch and upper gable window just behind; the house is plainer and tan at left and taller, paler and more ornate at right, but kind and layout agree.

Alice has the same long light-brown hair, young girl's face and slight build in both, facing the caterpillar at left and seated in the armchair at right, in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both show a grassy croquet lawn bordered by large leafy trees with a reddish brick garden wall behind and card-soldier hoops in the mid-distance; the right adds furrows and a foreground tree, which is compatible.

Alice (left in the armchair, right drinking in the hall) is a girl of about nine with long straight light-brown to auburn hair, fair skin and round face in both; the hair reads redder under the lamps on the right but length, style and age match.

The enclosing garden wall is red brick with loose orchard trees on the left but grey stone with formal clipped hedges and tall cypresses on the right; both are overcast lawns but the wall and planting conflict.
Alice in both is a fair-skinned girl with long light-brown hair held by a dark headband, same young face; hair is wavier and she looks a little taller on the left but no identity cue conflicts.
Alice (holding the flamingo on the left, standing tall in court on the right) has the same long light-brown hair with a dark headband, fair skin and young girl's face.
Alice (holding the flamingo on the left, drinking from the bottle on the right) has the same long light-brown hair with a headband, fair skin and young girl's face and build.

Both show a ridged, furrowed green lawn enclosed by a garden wall with tall trees and cypresses under a cloudy sky, with hedgehogs and card soldiers about; wall is grey stone on the left and redder brick on the right, a small difference.

Alice (left holding the flamingo; right facing the caterpillar) has long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, the same child's age and build, and the same yellow dress, white apron, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both show a long tea table set under a large spreading tree on grass in front of a pale clapboard house with a porch, in the same daylight; the table has a cloth on the right and bare wood on the left, but the place itself matches.

The Cheshire Cat (left floating behind Alice and the Queen; right crouched on the branch) is a striped tabby with dark stripes, pale muzzle, yellow-green eyes and a wide toothy grin in both; fur reads slightly browner on the left and greyer on the right.
